entities.name: UAC-0041
entities.gloss: A threat actor tracked by CERT-UA known for mass email distribution of infostealers.

entities.name: RelicRace
entities.gloss: A .NET-based downloader malware used to retrieve and execute subsequent payloads.

entities.name: RelicSource
entities.gloss: A .NET-based installer and loader malware used to decrypt and inject final payloads.

entities.name: Formbook
entities.gloss: An information-stealing malware designed to log keystrokes and exfiltrate credentials and system information.

entities.name: Snake Keylogger
entities.gloss: A modular .NET-based keylogger and infostealer capable of harvesting credentials and exfiltrating data.

entities.name: Telegram
entities.gloss: A cross-platform cloud-based instant messaging service frequently abused by threat actors for C2 communication.

entities.name: OneDrive
entities.gloss: A cloud storage and file synchronization service developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.tgz
entities.gloss: A compressed archive attachment distributed in phishing emails containing a malicious executable.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.tar
entities.gloss: A malicious tar archive file used in phishing campaigns.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious .NET executable implementing the RelicRace downloader.

entities.name: Mvbsbaoqmoffjfvhqvkpaia.dll
entities.gloss: A dynamic link library file associated with the RelicSource malware.

entities.name: formbook.exe
entities.gloss: An executable file containing the Formbook stealer payload.

entities.name: clientes@taximadridclass.com
entities.gloss: An email address observed sending malicious phishing messages.

entities.name: info@kivanclardokum.com.tr
entities.gloss: An email address observed sending malicious phishing messages.

entities.name: barbacoalosmartinez[.]com
entities.gloss: An internet domain observed in malicious network activity.
